name: Hatching
description: Fine engraved hatching behind or around your content: diagonal, horizontal, vertical, cross-hatched, or rows of seigaiha waves.

props.name: pattern
props.description: The hatch. Cross lays two diagonals over each other; waves draws overlapping rows of concentric arcs.

props.name: size
props.description: Distance between lines in pixels. For waves, the distance between the rings of each fan.

props.name: color
props.description: Line colour. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the lines out toward the edges, toward the top, or toward the bottom.

props.name: animate
props.description: Let the lines drift slowly, about 4 pixels a second. Stops with reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the layer, which is absolutely positioned to fill its parent behind the content (-z-10). Give the parent relative and isolate. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: frame
props.description: Width in pixels of a hatched frame around the children, ruled on both edges. At 0 the pattern fills the box behind them.
